translations.web: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.
translations.bsb: With the tongue we bless our Lord and Father, and with it we curse men, who have been made in God’s likeness.
translations.kjv: Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.
translations.asv: Therewith bless we the Lord and Father; and therewith curse we men, who are made after the likeness of God:
